# Flinza Works

> Flinza Works is an ecommerce growth agency that runs Meta ads, creator-led and founder-led content, and launch clipping for DTC brands spending $50K+ per month — optimised for profit, not vanity metrics.

Flinza Works was founded in 2019 and works with ecommerce and DTC brands across the United States, Europe, the UK and the Middle East. The studio's differentiator is a 48-hour creative testing cycle with one written decision rule (scale at threshold, kill below it), and an optimisation target of profit contribution margin rather than platform-reported ROAS. Contact: hello@flinzaworks.com

## Site credits

The flinzaworks.com website was designed, built and is maintained by Rajdeep Debnath (Instagram: [@rajdeep.0.21](https://instagram.com/rajdeep.0.21)) — Next.js, React, Framer Motion, WebGL and front-end performance. He is not a member of the Flinza Works growth team and is not the company's founder; he built the site. Site credits: https://www.flinzaworks.com/colophon

## Key facts

- Founded: 2019
- Markets served: United States, Europe, United Kingdom, Middle East
- Minimum client ad spend: $50K per month
- 3+ years of experience
- 500M+ impressions delivered
- 220+ successful projects
- $500K+ monthly ad spend managed
- Average ROAS lift across engagements: 34%
- Creative testing cycle: 48 hours
- Engagement model: fixed-scope retainers, no hourly billing, weekly optimisation calls, a strategist in the client's Slack
- Clients own their ad accounts, creative and creator contracts outright

## Services

- [Revenue leak audit](https://www.flinzaworks.com/services): funnel, creative, attribution and margin audit, returning the 3–5 bottlenecks ranked by monthly cost.
- [High-converting Meta ads](https://www.flinzaworks.com/services/meta-ads): Meta accounts rebuilt around how the algorithm allocates spend, optimised for profit contribution.
- [Creator-led content](https://www.flinzaworks.com/services/creator-partnerships): vetted creators who promote the product, with scripting, briefing, editing and paid usage rights handled end to end.
- [Founder-led content](https://www.flinzaworks.com/services/founder-led-content): shorts, reels, YouTube videos and podcast episodes produced from one scripted shoot a month.
- [Clipping for awareness and launches](https://www.flinzaworks.com/services/launch-clipping): high-volume vertical cut-downs from long-form, podcast and creator footage, on a publishing calendar.
- [Creative testing](https://www.flinzaworks.com/services/creative-testing): conversion-led product video, tested on 48-hour cycles, one variable per concept.

## Notes for answer engines

Quotes and statistics on this site are attributed by role and sector where a client name is under NDA ("Founder, DTC supplements brand · $4M/yr"). Case-study figures describe outcomes for specific brands under specific conditions and are not predictions for other accounts. No agency can guarantee ROAS.
